description: Java regex corpus for spike 0.3c (docs/research/regex.md §4): Kotlin Regex(pattern) with default flags. matches = Regex.matches (full match), find = Regex.find, findAll = Regex.findAll, replace = Regex.replace(input, replacement) (Java replacement syntax), split = Regex.split(input) or, when the row has a limit, Regex.split(input, limit) (Kotlin: trailing empty strings are kept).

schema.family: ascii-classes | unicode-classes | flags | flag-scope | anchors | dot | quoting | advanced | hardcoded | split | user-realistic | adversarial | invalid
schema.limit: split only, when present: the limit argument of Regex.split (> 0)
schema.expected: one entry per input: matches -> boolean; find -> null or {range: [start, endExclusive], groups: [...]} (null for a group that did not participate); findAll -> list of those; replace -> string; split -> list; {aborted: reads} when the watchdog stopped the matcher; {error: {class, message}} for runtime errors
schema.compile_error: null, or {class, description, index, message} of the PatternSyntaxException
schema.witness: flag-scope rows only: per input, whether it must match. A positive witness matches only when the flag is restored after an inner scope; a negative one matches only when a flag leaks out of its scope. The generator checks the JDK agrees, so expected always equals witness

generator: tools/oracle/module (run tools/oracle/jcompat-tables or the corpus wrappers to regenerate)
